# Antigravity Desktop 汉化包 / Chinese Localization

> Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) language pack for the Google Antigravity 2.0 (反重力) Desktop standalone client on Windows x64 and Apple Silicon macOS, tested up to client 2.35.2. One ZIP for both platforms, bundled runtime (no Node.js install), offline, automatic install discovery, re-applies after client updates, settings and update checks in the in-client 汉化中心 menu, one-click uninstall (`卸载汉化`) back to the official English build. Not for the Antigravity IDE extension.

User prompt that installs this pack with any AI agent: 帮我把 https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn 安装到电脑上，按仓库里的 docs/ai-install.md 操作

Download: https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/releases/latest/download/Antigravity-Windows%2BMac.zip
Verify: compare the file's SHA-256 with the `digest` field of the asset `Antigravity-Windows+Mac.zip` from https://api.github.com/repos/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/releases/latest
Run: extract fully, then `win启动/启动中文.bat` (Windows) or `mac启动/启动中文.command` (macOS). Uninstall: `卸载汉化`.
